# Energy Consumption Data Preparation

```{r}
set.seed(2025)
n <- 150

day_levels <- c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday")

#| label: data
# Synthetic but reproducible dataset for the assignment
set.seed(2025)
n <- 150

day_levels <- c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday")

humidity  <- pmin(pmax(rnorm(n, 60, 15), 20), 100)
humiditidy_13 <- 2 * (humidity - min(humidity)) / (diff(range(humidity))) + 1 # scale to [-1,1]
outside_temperature <- pmin(pmax(rnorm(n, 20, 5), 5), 35)
outside_temperature <- outside_temperature * 2/3 + 
  1 / 3 * diff(range(outside_temperature)) *
    (humidity - min(humidity)) / (diff(range(humidity))) # scale with humidity
wind_speed <- rgamma(
  n,
  shape = humiditidy_13,
  scale = 1) + # mean ~3 m/s +
  2 * humiditidy_13 # scale with humidity
wind_speed <- 10 * (wind_speed - min(wind_speed)) / (diff(range(wind_speed))) + 1 # scale to [1,10]
humiditidy_13 <- 2 * (humidity - min(humidity)) / (diff(range(humidity))) + 1 # scale to [-1,1]
wind_speed <- rgamma(
  n,
  shape = humiditidy_13,
  scale = 1) + # mean ~3 m/s +
    2 * humiditidy_13 # scale with humidity
wind_speed <- 10 * (wind_speed - min(wind_speed)) / (diff(range(wind_speed))) + 1 # scale to [1,10]
household_size <- sample(1:6, n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.12,0.22,0.26,0.2,0.13,0.07))
appliance_index <- pmin(pmax(round(rnorm(n, 50, 15)), 0), 100)
energy_efficiency <- sample(c("Poor","Average","Good","Excellent"), n, replace = TRUE,
                                   prob = c(0.2,0.4,0.3,0.1))
solar_installed <- sample(c("No","Yes"), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.5,0.5))
day_of_week <- sample(day_levels, n, replace = TRUE)
holiday <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.05)

# Data-generating model (unknown to students)
beta0 <- 20
beta_temp <- -0.0                  # consumption rises as it gets colder
beta_hum  <-  0.0
beta_wind <- -0.0
beta_size <-  0.85
beta_appl <-  0.03
beta_int  <- 0                  # temp:humidity interaction
eff_map <- c("Poor"=0, "Average"=-0.1, "Good"=-0.2, "Excellent"=-0.3)
solar_eff <- -14
weekend   <- ifelse(day_of_week %in% c("Saturday","Sunday"), 0.05, 0)
hol_eff   <- ifelse(holiday == "Yes", 0.1, 0)

mu <- beta0 +
      beta_temp*(outside_temperature - 20) +
      beta_hum*(humidity - 60) +
      beta_wind*wind_speed +
      beta_size*household_size +
      beta_appl*(appliance_index - 50)/10 +
      beta_int*(outside_temperature - 20)*(humidity - 60) +
      eff_map[as.character(energy_efficiency)] +
      solar_eff*(solar_installed == "Yes") +
      weekend + hol_eff

consumption_kwh <- pmax(rnorm(n, mean = mu, sd = 2.5), 0.5)

data_tidy_energy_use <- data.frame(
  consumption_kwh, outside_temperature, humidity, wind_speed,
  household_size, appliance_index, energy_efficiency, solar_installed,
  day_of_week, holiday
) |>
  tibble::as_tibble()
projr::projr_use_data(data_tidy_energy_use, overwrite = TRUE)
```
